scope: Original test_resiliency_tester.py read whole and Git blob verified; six fixture-independent original functions called unchanged. No setup_module, no scenario command execution, no altered fixture substitution.

findings.detail: Original file-diff tests copy same-length image content and change three byte positions; they do not test unequal lengths, zero-byte input or short stream reads. Passing tests do not refute v16 reproduced suffix/EOF defects.
Directory tests cover identical trees, modified bytes and missing outputs, but no extra output files. Asymmetric traversal therefore escapes those cases.
Average test uses matching stage names, metric keys, vector lengths and corpus size. No schema mismatch or failed-earlier/successful-last multi-run assertion.
test_main checks numeric returns for stochastic easy/hard configs; it has a TODO to inspect final stats. This test not run; its presence is not complete runtime qualification.
